design.hypothesis: LIE may have unusually small trainable residual to the contaminated coordinate-median anchor; test a persistent lower-tail cap on accepted M2
design.threshold_rule: minimum of all finite leave-one-principal-out residual ratios in clean seed103; strict ratio < threshold
design.reference: ratio to median of all other nominal-positive principals, including zero values; at least9 peers; median>1e-12; own principal excluded
design.history: consecutive eligible participations, normal or invalid observation resets; no decay on nonparticipation; no attack-label reset
design.holdout_rule: additional lower-tail applied flag rate <=1% on clean104; never retune if it fails
design.new_matrix: clean parent/candidate; Sign-flip parent/candidate/MK; Gaussian parent/candidate/MK/RFA; LIE .5 parent/candidate/MK
design.development_attack_use: diagnostics only; no threshold or persistence fitting on LIE44/45
design.scope: IID engineering candidate only; non-IID/targeted and other attacks remain pending
design.seed_revision_reason: 49 and 52 appeared in prior calibration/smoke artifacts; use 201/202 with no matching local run artifacts, before any new training

stop_rule: All 24 runs, each seed and each gate required; no optional stopping, retries, threshold/seed search. Reject new cap only on failure; retain accepted M2.
